biotools.summary: SA-ROC is a framework that defines operational safety in clinical AI systems, moving beyond standard accuracy metrics like AUC. It uses the SA-ROC curve to delineate safe zones for autonomous action and identifies a measurable 'Gray Zone' requiring human review.
